title: Bridging Scales in Chemotaxis: Scale-Uniform Forward Stability for Run-and-Tumble Kernel Estimation
summary: Chemotactic motion is described by run-and-tumble kinetic models at microscopic scales and by Keller--Segel equations at macroscopic scales. We develop variational loss functionals for estimating the two components $T_0(x)$ and $T_1(x)$ of a turning kernel $T_ε=T_0+εT_1$, where $T_0$ determines the leading-order turning rate and diffusion, while $T_1$ governs the macroscopic chemotactic drift.
